11	# Solution Design: SD-015 - Benchmark Workbench
12	
13	**Status:** Accepted
14	**Owner:** Fizeau Team
15	
16	> **Update 2026-05-16**: ADR-016 changes the cell schema — each
17	> `report.json` now embeds the full resolved profile snapshot. The
18	> workbench data pipeline (`scripts/website/build-benchmark-data.py`)
19	> reads embedded metadata; the `PROFILE_ALIASES` / `EXCLUDED_PROFILES`
20	> tables and profile-YAML joins are retired. Existing Parquet artifacts
21	> remain compatible; backfill ensures historical cells expose embedded
22	> metadata identical to the current join output. See
23	> `docs/helix/02-design/plan-2026-05-15-benchmark-runner-simplification.md`.
24	
25	## Summary
26	
27	SD-015 implements FEAT-008 as `/benchmarks/explorer/`: a static,
28	browser-side analytical workbench for benchmark cells. It replaces the
29	SD-014 DataTables explorer choice with a DuckDB-WASM + Parquet +
30	Perspective design while preserving the rest of the benchmark
31	information architecture.
32	
33	## Architecture
34	
35	```
36	scripts/website/build-benchmark-data.py
37	        |
38	        v
39	website/static/data/cells.parquet
40	website/static/data/task-combinations.parquet
41	        |
42	        v
43	/benchmarks/explorer/ Hugo page
44	        |
45	        v
46	benchmark-workbench.js
47	  - initializes DuckDB-WASM worker
48	  - registers Parquet files by URL
49	  - creates cells_enriched and workbench_cells SQL views
50	  - manages hash-addressable explorer panes
51	  - runs preset filters and aggregate SQL
52	  - runs pairwise model-family comparison SQL
53	  - loads workbench_cells into Perspective datagrid
54	```
55	
56	The browser owns the analytical session. Static hosting only needs to
57	serve HTML, CSS, JS, WASM, worker files, and Parquet artifacts.
58	
59	## Page Structure
60	
61	`website/content/benchmarks/explorer/_index.md` contains a single
62	instrument-panel workbench with persistent local navigation. The
63	navigation entries are hash routes, not Hugo subpages:
64	
65	- `#summary`
66	- `#data`
67	- `#compare`
68	- `#combinations`
69	
70	`benchmark-workbench.js` owns this small router by reading
71	`window.location.hash`, toggling `[data-bw-pane]`, and marking the
72	matching `[data-bw-route]` link with `aria-current="page"`. The design
73	keeps the left navigation fixed on desktop and turns it into a compact
74	top local nav on narrow screens.
75	
76	The panes are:
77	
78	- Summary: result-bearing dataset explanation, unfiltered aggregate
79	  metrics, task-type/GPU distribution charts, and wall-time charts by
80	  GPU and model.
81	- Raw database: raw search, outcome/task/model/engine/GPU/RAM controls,
82	  enum filters, saved views, current aggregate readouts, and the
83	  Perspective datagrid with every cell column available.
84	- Comparison: pairwise model-family controls, comparison scope filters,
85	  and the sortable pairwise gap table.
86	- Combinations: task/model/GPU/pass controls and the sortable
87	  combination aggregate table.
88	
89	The workbench lives outside the prose-width cap. It uses full available
90	viewport width and a stable grid height so the table is not trapped in a
91	small report table container.
92	
93	## SQL Views
94	
95	`cells_raw`
96	
97	Reads `cells.parquet` directly. The builder filters this artifact to
98	result-bearing rows only:
99	
100	- `result_state = "timeout"` when the run hit the explicit benchmark

14	# ADR-016: Cells Are Self-Describing Evidence
15	
16	| Date | Status | Deciders | Related | Confidence |
17	|------|--------|----------|---------|------------|
18	| 2026-05-16 | Accepted | Fizeau maintainers | ADR-007, ADR-015, SD-009, SD-010, SD-012 | High |
19	
20	## Context
21	
22	The benchmark runner accumulated six overlapping concepts in
23	`scripts/benchmark/terminalbench-2-1-sweep.yaml` (~2000 lines): subsets,
24	recipes, lanes, comparison groups, resource groups, and lane aliases. The
25	operator pain symptoms are concrete:
26	
27	- Adding a model required edits in 3–4 places (profile YAML, lane block,
28	  recipe enrollment, shell alias case arm). The `fiz-vidar-ds4-mtp`
29	  incident left a lane half-wired with a missing profile, missing recipe
30	  membership, and a missing alias.
31	- A simple URL change (e.g. lucebox endpoint port 1236 → 8080) required
32	  updating `metadata.endpoint`, `provider.base_url`, the snapshot string,
33	  `resource_groups[].base_url`, the lane's `FIZEAU_BASE_URL`, and the
34	  lane's denormalized `endpoint` field. `cmd/bench/sweep.go:910-919`
35	  validates that lane env matches profile fields, forcing the duplication
36	  to be kept in sync by hand.
37	- The closed EPIC `fizeau-62693ed0` ("simplify benchmark lane authoring")
38	  responded by adding more Go tooling (`fiz-bench lanes clone`,
39	  `validateSweepLaneEnvMatch`) rather than reducing the multi-file
40	  structure. That solved authoring papercuts but locked in the
41	  duplication.
42	- Analytics scripts (`scripts/website/build-benchmark-data.py:150`)
43	  maintain a `PROFILE_ALIASES` rename map plus an `EXCLUDED_PROFILES` set
44	  because profile IDs in older cells refer to YAMLs that no longer exist
45	  in `scripts/benchmark/profiles/`. As of 2026-05-16 there are 4 orphan
46	  profile IDs (`sindri-club-3090`, `vidar-qwen3-6-27b-openai-compat`,
47	  `sindri-club-3090-llamacpp`, `gpt-5-3-mini`) covering 663 cell
48	  directories.
49	- The `comparison_groups:` block in the sweep YAML is referenced only by
50	  the sweep YAML itself and lane-meta JSON — zero Python readers.
